name: coding-agent-skills
description: Verified, portable engineering skills for agent-ready repositories, with quality contracts, security checks, behavioral-evaluation fixtures, and optional coding-agent delegation adapters.

plugins.name: coding-agent-skills
plugins.description: A curated cross-agent engineering skillpack for understanding, planning, validating, reviewing, securing, maintaining, and operating software repositories.

skills.name: repository-discovery
skills.description: Discovers architecture, conventions, boundaries, and validation commands before planning changes.

skills.name: issue-to-implementation-plan
skills.description: Turns issues and feature requests into repository-informed implementation plans with acceptance criteria and validation.

skills.name: migration-planning
skills.description: Designs staged, compatible, reversible migrations for APIs, schemas, dependencies, and architecture.

skills.name: ci-failure-triage
skills.description: Finds the first actionable CI failure, reproduces it narrowly, and drives the smallest evidence-backed fix.

skills.name: test-gap-analysis
skills.description: Finds material behavior and failure modes that are insufficiently tested.

skills.name: change-risk-assessment
skills.description: Assesses blast radius, compatibility, security, reversibility, and validation risk for a change.

skills.name: pull-request-review
skills.description: Performs high-signal pull-request review for correctness, regressions, security, contracts, and missing tests.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Performs repository-scoped security review using trust boundaries and realistic abuse paths.

skills.name: dependency-remediation
skills.description: Applies conservative native remediation for known dependency vulnerabilities without broad upgrades.

skills.name: documentation-sync
skills.description: Synchronizes documentation with verified repository behavior using narrowly scoped edits.

skills.name: release-readiness
skills.description: Evaluates release candidates for validation, compatibility, migration, packaging, security, documentation, and rollback readiness.

skills.name: orchestrating-parallel-tasks
skills.description: Decomposes complex work into dependency-aware, mutually exclusive tasks that agents can execute safely in parallel.

skills.name: claude-code-cli
skills.description: Delegates work to Claude Code CLI while mapping the request to the least-privileged native permission mode.

skills.name: codex-cli
skills.description: Delegates work to Codex CLI while mapping the request to the least-privileged native sandbox and approval mode.

skills.name: cursor-agent-cli
skills.description: Delegates work to Cursor Agent CLI with structured planning, question-answering, and automation modes.

skills.name: copilot-cli
skills.description: Delegates work to GitHub Copilot CLI using the safest native permission mode for the task.

skills.name: pi-agent-cli
skills.description: Delegates work to Pi with explicit least-privilege tool allowlists.

skills.name: fx-agent-cli
skills.description: Delegates narrowly scoped work to the Vercel Labs fx coding agent while preserving native permission review.

skills.name: antigravity-cli
skills.description: Delegates work to Google Antigravity CLI using native fine-grained allow, ask, and deny permissions.
